EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.:BPN/L/3/2/11/ii, Ministry of Lands and Land Development’s.
Reference No. : LD/05/2010/IR/254.

I, hereby inform, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government has proposed to obtain the under mentioned lands for public purpose. Particulars of lands proposed to obtain:

A portion of lands about 0.3949 Hectare in extent from the lands situated in the village of Pollebeddayaya in Pollebeddala Grama Niladhari division in Maha Oya Divisional Secretariat Division in Ampara District and lands which are called Kelavinna and Pollebeddayaya have been depicted as lots Nos. 2962 - 2963 in interim plan No. 154 of primary plan No. Topo 24 and bounded as follows within the following boundaries:
01.Lot No. 2962— Pollebeddayaya— Extent 0.1988 Hectare— Tala Bandaralage Ranjith Karunasena
North: Lot No.2964;East: Lot No. 2964; South: Lot No.2964; West: Lot No.2964;
02.Lot No. 2963— Pollebeddayaya— Extent 0.1961 Hectare— Hearth Bandaralage Ratnasiri Bandara
North: Lot No.2964;East: Lot No. 2964; South: Lot No.2964; West: Lot No.2964;

All the persons who claim ownership or other eligibility for the lands should present personally or with the authorized documents of the owners on 09.08.2016 at 10.00 a.m. at the Divisional Secretariat Division of Maha Oya to be interviewed.

All those who claim ownership for the land should submit their application in duplicate from 03.08.2016 with the details of the nature of ownership, the reasons for requesting compensation, amount of compensation and the way of calculation calculated the amount of compensation. The deeds of the land claims ownership should be submitted for inspection.
B.V.S. GUNASENA, Divisional Secretary, Maha Oya. 8th July 2016, Divisional Secretariat, Maha Oya. 07 - 983/1
